correctness.rationale: For two distinct positive occupancy levels r,s, specified-box multinomial moments give Cov=m² P_r P_s(R-1), R=(m-1)/m *(N-r)_s/(N)_s * (1-2/m)^(N-r-s)/(1-1/m)^(2N-r-s). Taylor expansion at N/m=alpha gives log R=-(alpha+1-r-s+rs/alpha)/m + [-2alpha+(3(r+s)-1)/2-rs(r+s-1)/(2alpha²)]/m²+O(m^-3). For square pairs r=j²,s=(j+1)²,a=j(j+1), the first coefficient is (alpha-a)²/alpha and second at alpha=a is 1. Thus Cov->e^-2a a^(r+s)/(r!s!)*(1-z²/a). Independent symbolic j=1 calculation yields 4 e^-4/3; direct coefficient comparison matches two earlier full theorems. The integer square-pair completeness follows rational sqrt(r) integer. Finite enumerations check only small m,N.
